# Personal Information Processors

BombBomb works with carefully selected third-party service providers to support infrastructure, analytics, communication, and customer experience. Below is a list of processors with whom we may share personal information as part of delivering our services.

- [Amazon Web Services (AWS)](https://aws.amazon.com/)
- [Backupify](https://www.backupify.com/)
- [Chargebee](https://www.chargebee.com/)
- [DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)
- [Gainsight](https://www.gainsight.com/)
- [GitHub, Inc.](https://github.com/)
- [Google](https://www.google.com/)
- [HubSpot](https://www.hubspot.com/)
- [Microsoft](https://www.microsoft.com/)
- [Okta Inc (Auth0)](https://auth0.com/)
- [OpenAI](https://www.openai.com/)
- [Salesforce](https://www.salesforce.com/)
- [Zendesk](https://www.zendesk.com/)
